integrity: Finite exact checks and algebraic identity replay accompany a complete analytical proof; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula concerns a single specified fixed-point indicator and the total inversion count for n>=3, theta>0. It does not assert independence at zero covariance, a central limit theorem, a joint distribution, or originality of the known unconditional inversion mean. Historical priority beyond the inspected sources is not independently certified.
title: A centered parabolic covariance law for fixed points and inversions under Ewens sampling
